# CET TEST

> Government exam preparation platform for Haryana, Uttarakhand, Railway and SSC exams — mock tests, study material and live exam alerts.

## Key Pages
- [Exam Alerts](https://cettest.site/exam-alerts): Live official government exam notifications
- [Mock Tests](https://cettest.site/mock-test): Free practice tests for HSSC CET, SSC and Railway
- [Study Materials](https://cettest.site/study-materials): Subject-wise preparation content
- [HSSC CET Exam Page](https://cettest.site/exams/hssc-cet): Detailed exam pattern, syllabus and FAQs

## Exam alert sources
Alerts link to official sources including HSSC, HPSC, UKSSSC, UKPSC, Railway Recruitment Boards and SSC.

## Contact
For questions about an alert, contact CET TEST through the contact details listed on the website.
